scientific_integrity: An analytic one-crossing proof establishes the continuous parameter classification; finite numerical verification independently checks formulas and examples but is not used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-node symmetric interpolatory Gaussian rule for Lebesgue measure on [-1,1] is classified.
No claim of constant exactness, absolute quadrature error optimality, or floating-point stability.
Polynomial augmentation, oversampling, asymmetric points, and other kernels are excluded.
No independent scientific audit or exhaustive publication-priority guarantee.
title: A one-crossing positivity diagram for symmetric three-node Gaussian kernel quadrature
